provenance.gpu_vram_bandwidth: Architectural reference peaks, not measured Q2/Q3 throughput
provenance.compute_resources: Work is measured milliseconds per operation, capacity 1
provenance.cache_bytes: Illustrative AMD-primary decode partition: CUDA worker 10 GiB, HIP primary 6 GiB, RAM 95 GiB. Not a deployed measurement. Override exact per-phase allocations/cache capacities.
provenance.ram_capacity: 125 GiB usable minus 8 GiB host reserve
provenance.host_bounce: Explicit conservative cross-NUMA host copy; paths may be refined after transport profiling
provenance.cpu_memory_resources: Conditional even interleaving across NUMA nodes; override for measured placement
provenance.return_bytes_per_row: CPU uploads all eight expert slots; mixed GPU device reduction returns one vector per token. Strict per-expert transport needs a different profile.
provenance.link_encoding_bytes_per_ms: PCIe 3: 8 GT/s, 128/130 encoding, 8 bits/byte; excludes packet overhead. Not measured throughput.
provenance.gpu_memory_capacity: Operative runner allocation limits: NVIDIA 14336 MiB minus 1024 MiB reserve; AMD 15360 minus 1024. Reported device availability is retained separately.
provenance.storage_io: docs/benchmarks/tr16_mixed_20261014/storage_small_reads.json; QD1 mean latency, QD4 held out; 8 MiB throughput supplies shared bandwidth.
provenance.storage_read_bytes: Illustrative 1 MiB O_DIRECT cold-tier reads, full-block tail overfetch charged. Existing mmap demand faults require a different read-size profile.
